_comment: Connection profiles. A profile only pre-fills the two fields that are
awkward to discover by hand: where to fetch a server list, and the Host
header the frontend expects. Everything else still comes from the list
or from what you type. Add your own entries here; nothing in the code
is specific to any of them.

profiles.name: Self-hosted / manual
profiles.note: Fill in the server fields yourself. See docs/SELF-HOSTING.md.

profiles.name: Provider (v5 list API)
profiles.note: Server list, shared id and ingest port all come from the endpoint.
